props.name: className
props.comment: Extra class names applied to the `<form>` element.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Disables the button and shows a spinner from outside the form.

props.name: onSubmit
props.comment:
Called with the credentials instead of `authProvider.login`. A rejection
is shown as an error notification.

props.name: redirectTo
props.comment:
Path the user is redirected to after a successful sign in. Passed to
`authProvider.login`; ignored when `onSubmit` is set.

props.name: submitLabel
props.comment: Button text. Defaults to the translated `chelone.auth.sign_in`.
